title: Browser Extensions & Privacy Add-ons Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your browser extension privacy risk. Assess permissions, sources, and data access to protect your browsing privacy and security.
description: Evaluate the privacy and security risks of your browser extensions. Our calculator analyzes extension permissions, update frequency, sources, and data access to provide a comprehensive risk assessment for your browser add-ons.

formula: const baseRisk = Math.min(extensionCount * 2, 20); const unknownSourceRisk = unknownSourceCount * 15; const permissionRisk = highPermissionCount * 10; const outdatedRisk = outdatedCount * 8; const dataRisk = dataCollection * 12; const privacyBonus = privacyExtensions === 'none' ? 0 : privacyExtensions === 'some' ? -5 : -10; const reviewBonus = reviewsCheck === 'never' ? 10 : reviewsCheck === 'sometimes' ? 5 : -5; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk + unknownSourceRisk + permissionRisk + outdatedRisk + dataRisk + privacyBonus + reviewBonus)); const riskLevel = riskScore < 20 ? 'Low Risk' : riskScore < 40 ? 'Moderate Risk' : riskScore < 65 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; const securityGrade = riskScore < 20 ? 'A' : riskScore < 35 ? 'B' : riskScore < 50 ? 'C' : riskScore < 70 ? 'D' : 'F'; const recommendedActions = (unknownSourceCount > 0 ? 1 : 0) + (outdatedCount > 2 ? 1 : 0) + (highPermissionCount > 3 ? 1 : 0) + (privacyExtensions === 'none' ? 1 : 0); return { riskScore, riskLevel, securityGrade, recommendedActions };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates browser extension privacy risks based on key factors: extension count, source reliability, permissions scope, update frequency, and data collection practices. The scoring system weighs unknown sources and broad permissions most heavily, as these pose the greatest privacy threats.
tips: Only install extensions from official browser stores like Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons
Regularly review and remove unused extensions to minimize your attack surface
Check extension permissions before installing - avoid those requesting excessive access
Use reputable privacy extensions like uBlock Origin, Privacy Badger, or DuckDuckGo Privacy Essentials
Keep all extensions updated to the latest versions for security patches
Read user reviews and check developer reputation before installing new extensions
Consider using Incognito Browser for sensitive browsing to limit extension access
Audit your extensions quarterly and remove any that haven't been updated recently
